semantic_slots.objects: E,V,alpha,beta,eta; c,Phi,S,rate,Lambda,tau; tagged next and record; exponential product P and epsilon; Rec,Hist,history H,readTime; Delta,Prefix,comap measure m; zAt,K,qReal,q; A,B,obs and nonnegative extended test function F.
semantic_slots.domains: Finite-dimensional real inner-product Borel E including rank zero; V:E->R; alpha,beta>=0; eta real; y,r in E; z0 in E x E; n in N,T>=0; input Omega=R^N; Rec=([0,infinity) x (E x E)) disjoint-union singleton; Hist(n)=Rec^(n+1); Prefix(n,T)={0<t1<...<tn<T} as subtype of R^n, vacuous for n=0; tau in [0,infinity]; q and F extended nonnegative.
semantic_slots.quantifiers: For every ambient E,V,alpha,beta,eta satisfying all hypotheses, every finite n and T>=0: measurable Delta,A and joint measurability of K,q in y,r,z0,t. For every y,r,z0: measurable H,B,obs; for every prefix t nonnegative qReal; for every w in B existence of matching prefix; equality of history measures; for every measurable extended-nonnegative F the integral identity; exact density mass P(B)<=1.
semantic_slots.assumptions: V is C2; 0<alpha<=beta; alpha||v||^2<=D^2V(x)[v,v]<=beta||v||^2 for all x,v; eta>0; beta eta<=1; finite-dimensional real inner-product Borel structure. No higher derivatives, nonzero reflection normal, law for initial state, nonexplosion premise, final survival condition, or integrability premise for F.
semantic_slots.conclusion: Actual independent Exp(1) inputs produce finite accepted marked histories with unnormalized law H_*(P restricted to B)=K_*(q m). Accepted histories reconstruct pointwise from time prefixes. q is the product of n pre-reflection rates and n segment survival factors. Measurability, qReal>=0, every nonnegative extended test-function identity, and integral q=P(B)<=1 are asserted. There is no terminal survival factor, hence no exactly-n event-count law.
semantic_slots.scopes: Finite strict prefixes before T. Relative segment times, absolute stored times. Stored states are post-reflection; rates are evaluated pre-reflection. Tau infinity is checked before untopD; cemetery is absorbing. A does not itself impose starting time/state or dynamics. m is unnormalized subtype Lebesgue comap. Restriction is not conditioning. n=0 gives unit initial-history mass even at T=0; n>=1,T=0 gives zero mass. No nonexplosion, exact count, expected costs or state at T is asserted.
semantic_slots.constant_dependencies: No unnamed or asymptotic constants. alpha,beta only constrain V and eta. Formulas depend on V,eta,y,r,z0 and times. n sets finite history/prefix size. T constrains the prefix domain without a terminal evolution factor. P always has exponential rate one.
